claim: In a 6-3 decision (Justice Stevens writing), the Court denied immunity to Alabama guards who handcuffed inmate Larry Hope to a "hitching post" in the sun for seven hours, holding officials "can be on notice that their conduct violates established law even in novel factual circumstances."
